problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 4 \\ 1 & 2 & -1 \\ 4 & -1 & -3\end{aligned}]
$$

Given the matrix $A$ above, evaluate the quadratic form $Q(x)={x}^{T}\,Ax$ when $x=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 2 \\ -1\end{aligned}].$
worked_solution:
Substituting $x=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 2 \\ -1\end{aligned}]$ into the expression for $Q(x),$ we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}Q(x) & ={x}^{T}\,Ax \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 4 \\ 1 & 2 & -1 \\ 4 & -1 & -3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 2 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-3 & 4 & -3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 2 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =14.\end{aligned}
$$
